# Third-party code Leyline links or imports, one row each: kind, name, SPDX licence, vendored text.
# scripts/check-licenses.sh keeps this table equal to what the build actually pulls in (go.mod's
# dependency graph, engine/Package.resolved) and refuses copyleft outside engine/. Add a row, with
# the licence text copied beside it, when you add a dependency; the NOTICE file names each row.
# A licence column may list several SPDX ids separated by commas when every one of them applies
# (a module whose files are under different licences); each must be allowed where it is used.
#
